t: You're looking at Hibbert's Almshouses in Lambeth, a row of almshouses that commemorates William Hibbert. He lived from 1759 to 1844 and was a merchant, planter and slave trader. With his brother George and his cousin Robert, he was a partner in the West Indian merchant house Geo. Rob. and Wm. Hibbert. The firm was involved in the slave trade, and mainly handled the shipping, insurance and distribution of sugar from the West Indies. So the name on this building ties it to that trade and the wealth it produced.
